diagnosis: Symptoms match kb-0006: an IdP signing certificate rotation without updating our SAML metadata causes assertion validation failures. Recommend customer re-upload the IdP metadata and test with a single account before re-enabling enforcement.
reply: Thank you for the details. This sounds like a metadata mismatch after your identity provider certificate change: when the signing certificate is rotated, the metadata we hold needs to be refreshed or sign-in fails with an assertion error. Please re-upload your IdP metadata from your admin settings, then test sign-in with a single account before re-enabling SSO enforcement. Let us know if the issue persists after that and we will investigate further.
